description: Experimental n0-snap atproto + iroh device binding. Not a standardized namespace. Signed DRISL record (excluding proof) plus signed repository inclusion are both required.

main.description: Record key is the lowercase 64-character hex iroh endpoint ID. Delete the record to revoke account-based connections. Public data; never include secrets or relay tokens.

iss.description: Account DID; must equal the containing repository DID.

sub.description: Ed25519 did:key encoding of the native iroh endpoint public key.

proof.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature over canonical DRISL CBOR of the complete record with proof omitted.
